behavior: AC1 - writing one thread leaves every other thread byte-identical, and everything outside the handoff section untouched, on a fixture shaped like the actual clobber
AC2 + AC3 - writing identical content reports changed=false and alters nothing; new content replaces rather than appends; a new thread is appended without reordering existing ones
AC4 - the writer and extractHandoffBlock agree on the section boundary, so a thread-scoped file still archives whole; asserted by driving the archiver over the written output
AC5 - a missing handoff section and an empty thread key are loud errors, never a silent append or a blanked thread
AC6 + AC7 - the thread key resolves from any subdirectory of a worktree (not just its root), and a journal filename is derivable from the working directory and distinct per worktree
